description: This script is a Perl source file for creating a firmware image, specifically a replacement for brcmImagebuilder. It handles reading image files, padding, and constructing a firmware image with headers and partitions, including options for dual images and specific memory addresses.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into a scalar buffer.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the padding length needed to align data to a specified block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to align to a block size, considering an offset.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Constructs a firmware image with headers and partitions, and writes it to the output file.
